note: Printed claims only (Step 6). Wires: all 49 image-read at 600 dpi of PDF p.39 and in printed order; they match the programs.json record except one line, which the page prints as 4H/5L and the OCR record (programs.json wiresPrinted/wiresCorrected/wiresEffective, programs.md V-EXP19) carries as 4H/5U. The fixture uses the page. With 4H/5U the run fails 43 lamp observations in 32 of the 60 expects (18 observations in 12 of the 26 first-contact expects), and with 4H/5L all pass. ER-38 is prose only and changes no wire, so errata_applied is empty. It is honoured by the script, which turns the dial only clockwise once power is on. Script: the printed procedure is run once per letter, for all 26 letters of the p.32 table. Each run turns power off, sets the dial to 0, turns power on, turns the dial clockwise one contact at a time to the letter, lets go and reads the lamps. The page gives one procedure per letter and does not say how to move between letters, so the power-off reset is a script choice. Each letter is stopped on the first contact of its dial-plate sector reached turning clockwise from 0 (p.33 plate: Band 1 E 0-7, T 8-15; Band 2 I, A, N, M on 4 contacts each from 0; Band 3 S, U, R, W, D, K, G, O on 2 contacts each from 0; Band 4 H 0, V 1, F 2, L 4, P 6, J 7, B 8, X 9, C 10, Y 11, Z 12, Q 13, with 3, 5, 14 and 15 blank). Each expect asserts only the lights the band rule says to read (Band n: lights 3 to 2+n), each on for a dash and off for a dot of the letter's printed Morse Code. Lights outside the band are not asserted. The p.33 plate prints each Band 1-3 letter across its whole sector, so the pointer is pointing at that letter at every contact in the sector; a second set of runs stops at each later contact (1-7, 9-15) and asserts every Band 1-3 letter whose sector holds that contact. Not asserted: the dial position, which is the script's input and not a printed observable; and any Band 4 reading at the blank cells 3, 5, 14 and 15. Knife-edge: minDecisionUa 7 is below the profile's 14, so the knife-edge trigger trips; the decision is relay 6 pulling in at contact 11 (coil 45220 uA, 7 uA over pull-in), the state the Y expect and the K-at-contact-11 expect read (light 5, and for Y light 6, light through it) and one the M, G, O, Z and Q runs and the second-set runs at contacts 12-15 pass through; all six BLESS-ROBUSTNESS perturbations held. Hand slew, contact arc and dead gap are profile fallbacks (O-R1).
